About Us

NFT Shark was created as a showcase project to demonstrate the power of NFTpay, a venture-backed crypto startup based in Miami, Florida. Our team is comprised of 5 cofounders that have successful backgrounds, multiple exits, and have payment, blockchain, and cyber security backgrounds.

We built NFT Shark so you can buy an NFT from OpenSea in one minute. NFT Shark ends up being way less expensive, way less hassle, and gives you more time in your day to do what you love! NFT Shark is 100% secure. Learn more about us here.
